about: The assistants' test bench: orders and what each one should do. "tool": a tool (or a list: any of them) it must use; "noTool": it answers without tools; "answerContains": something it must say (any of the list); "command": one of your K-Desktop commands it must run, by name (or a list). Tools that do something do not really do it during the test.
